name: World Clock
summary: Live clocks for cities around the world — add zones, pause, and compare offsets locally.
description: Watch the current time update every second across UTC and major cities. Add or remove timezones from a curated list, pause the tick, and jump to the Timezone Converter for one-off conversions. Nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: How often does it update?
faqs.answer: Once per second while running. Use Pause to freeze the display.

faqs.question: Which cities are available?
faqs.answer: A curated set of IANA timezones (New York, London, Tokyo, and more). You can mix any of them on the board.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Times are computed in your browser with the Intl API.
